en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Hammad, from Aamir Bin Nuaym who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about these house which the people lodge in, where is the urines of the animals, and the compost, and the Jews and the Christians tend to enter it. How can on pray Salāt in it?’ Heasws said: ‘Pray Salāt upon your clothes’.
en.sarwar: 25. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Hammad from ‘Amir ibn Nu’aym who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of these houses where people lodge, in which there is urine of animals and dung, where Jews and Christians enter. How is one to perform Salah (prayer)? He (the Imam) said, ‘Perform Salah (prayer) on your clothes.’”
